app.name: ValorMóvil
app.tagline: See how much of your phone you really use — and how much money sits unused.
app.noPublishedMatch: No model sheet in the local catalog; measured values only.
app.version: Version {{version}} · install the new APK over the previous one

onboarding.orRemeasure: Or measure again below («Read phone data» / calculate).
onboarding.priceLabel: Purchase price of your current phone (€)
onboarding.intentLegend: How you’ll use the next phone
onboarding.intentHint: You can pick several. This does not change measurement of your current phone — it only ranks recommendations. If you pick none, we follow your usage with a little headroom.
onboarding.nativeHint: Reads UsageStats on device. The app list is never uploaded.
onboarding.browserOnly: In the browser you only get demo/synthetic data. Install the Android APK to read real UsageStats.
onboarding.usageSettingsHint: Enable «ValorMóvil» under Usage Access, then come back and tap Read data.
onboarding.permOk: Permission granted. You can read data now.
onboarding.needUsage: You need to grant Usage Access in system Settings.
onboarding.storageWarn: Note: storage could not be read. The rest was measured; Storage stays estimated.
onboarding.storageNoteSuffix: Storage could not be read; that category stays estimated.

dashboard.title: Your utilization
dashboard.showRecs: See phones that fit · up to {{budget}} €
dashboard.thinHistory: ⚠ Thin history (under 7 days): figures may shift. Use the phone a few more days and measure again.
dashboard.unmeasuredBody: You’re viewing a {{source}} profile. It does not reflect your real usage. On Android, use «Read phone data».

recs.title: Recommendations
recs.subtitle: They match your measured usage{{extra}}. They update instantly.
recs.subtitleIntents: and what you want from the next phone
recs.intentTitle: How you’ll use the next phone
recs.empty: No catalog phone passes those filters. Try widening the price or removing brands.
recs.tapWaste: Tap to see price and wasted euros
recs.featuresHint: Based on your usage, this is what you’d use of each part.
recs.wasteLead: Of that price, this would be wasted
recs.wasteSub: of those {{price}} €, with your current usage

compare.title: Compare ({{n}})
compare.hint: % = how much of each category you’d use on that phone, with your measured usage. Wasted euros use the same engine as the detail sheet.

transparency.measuredBody: This session uses UsageStats{{days}} and local signals (storage, battery, network). Categories marked measured come from the phone; estimated ones are inferred. The app list is never uploaded.
transparency.noteBody: In the native Android app, ValorMóvil uses the UsageStats API and system signals for real usage. This view uses {{source}} — figures illustrate the idea. Install the APK to measure your device.
transparency.catalogPrices: Recommendation prices come from the catalog feed (orientative), not live checkout. Purchase links are neutral searches — no affiliates or commission tracking.

budget.enough: With your usage, a ~{{enough}} € phone fits; above {{above}} € you gain almost nothing.

soc.label: Processor (SoC)
soc.how: Estimated from typical CPU/GPU load for your usage profile. On real Android this uses UsageStats and performance sampling.

pantalla.label: Display
pantalla.how: Based on screen-on time, average brightness and refresh rate used. A barely used 120 Hz panel is wasted.

camara.label: Camera
camara.how: Photo/video frequency and advanced modes used. Extra sensors you never use are wasted.

storage.label: Storage
storage.how: Used space vs usable capacity (as in Settings). Lots of empty storage = unused euros.

ram.label: RAM
ram.how: Peak and average RAM in use versus installed capacity.

bateria.label: Battery & charging
bateria.how: Daily cycles, real endurance and use of fast/wireless charging.

conectividad.label: Connectivity
conectividad.how: Use of 5G, Wi-Fi 6/7, NFC and Bluetooth. Unused premium bands hurt the score.

audio.label: Audio
audio.how: Media playback, stereo speakers and mics used in calls/recording.

sensores.label: Sensors & payments
sensores.how: Fingerprint, face unlock, NFC payments, compass, gyro and health sensors.

software.label: Software & brand
software.how: Perceived value of updates, ecosystem and brand extras versus real use.

specs.usageSentence: {{short}} ({{spec}}): based on your usage you’d use about {{pct}} %.
